# Ghostly

> Zero-config skeleton loaders for React. CSS-first engine that transforms your existing components into skeleton loading states. No CLI, no build step, no code changes. ~3KB gzipped.

Ghostly uses pure CSS to convert your real component layout into animated placeholder blocks. Your component IS the skeleton — Ghostly hides text and images via CSS, preserving the exact same structure, spacing, and dimensions.

## Packages

- `@ghostly-ui/core`: CSS engine + TypeScript types (zero dependencies, framework-agnostic)
- `@ghostly-ui/react`: React components (`<Ghostly>`, `<GhostlyList>`, `<GhostlyProvider>`, `useGhostly()`)
